audit.whatIsWrong: Three kit interactions weren't reaching the page: Mana Barrier (P) / Static Field (R) shield absorbs burst (changes all-in math), Power Fist (E) opens with an auto-attack reset tell before the knockup, and Static Field (R) silences on activation so an escape must be pre-emptive, not reactive.
audit.why: Each is a concrete, checkable cue: force the shield out before committing, step back on the E wind-up rather than the cast, and don't waste your escape after he's already silenced you.
audit.corrected: Folded the shield/auto-reset tell into dosFull[0].d and the silence-timing cue into dontsFull[0].d.
